## Habit Tracker

A simple yet powerful habit tracking app built with SwiftUI, helping you build and maintain positive habits.

### Features

- Track multiple habits simultaneously
- Streak tracking and statistics
- Customizable reminders
- Beautiful, intuitive interface
- Dark mode support

### Development

I built this app while sharpening my SwiftUI skills.

### Support

Having issues or have suggestions? [Contact me](mailto:mg@markgingrass.com) or visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mtgingrass/SimpleHabit).

### Privacy

Habit Tracker respects your privacy. All data is stored locally on your device.
